This is R3 (.github, AGENTS.md), so it needs reviews/<PR>/reviewer.md and owner.md before merge.\n\n## What it adds\n- **desk-build.yml**: runs on every pull request and on pushes to main touching src/** or tests/**. It holds no secret, uses no environment and uploads nothing. It runs the config check, then `npm --prefix src ci --ignore-scripts`, the build and the tests. Before M1 (no src/) it passes with a note.\n- **desk-deploy.yml**: runs on a push to main touching src/** (the preview job) or on a workflow_dispatch with `job` (preview, production or exp-002), `sha` and `note` inputs.\n  - Every job runs in an environment where the owner is the required reviewer, with its own concurrency group and cancel-in-progress false.\n  - Each job checks out with fetch-depth 0.\n  - `desk_pick_commit.sh` handles the commit choice. A push run deploys exactly github.sha. A dispatch run gets the SHA through env. It fetches `+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main` with the token passed as a header on that one command. It then requires 40 hex characters, `merge-base --is-ancestor`, and `git diff --quiet \"$SHA\" origin/main -- src .github/workflows .github/deploy-tools .github/scripts`.\n  - The config check runs again on that commit with `--require`.\n  - wrangler is installed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix .github/deploy-tools` and called by absolute path. The Cloudflare token sits in the deploy step's env only.\n  - **production** has `permissions: {contents: read, actions: read}`. `desk_preview_check.py` requires that the newest successful `preview` job deployed the same SHA. The project and branch stay empty until M3 (EXP-002), so the job refuses to deploy before then.\n  - **exp-002** runs `wrangler pages project list` in the `preview` environment.\n  - run-name follows the spec's form.\n- **.github/deploy-tools/**: wrangler 4.148.0 pinned, with its lockfile. All 91 resolved URLs point to registry.npmjs.org. `.npmrc` pins the registry.\n- **.github/scripts/desk_config_check.py**:\n  - wrangler.toml may hold only name, pages_build_output_dir = \"public\" and compatibility_date;\n  - src/package.json may have no dependencies block and none of the listed lifecycle scripts.\n- **governance.yml**: the Tests step now runs the build and test commands (CS4).\n- **AGENTS.md §8**: the `build:` and `test:` line (CS4).\n\n## Choices beyond the spec's text\n- The `job` dispatch input picks one job, so a dispatch never queues all three for approval.\n- actions/setup-node is pinned at v6.5.0 (2499707…), because wrangler 4 needs Node 22 or later.\n\n## Checked locally\n- `npm ci --ignore-scripts` of the lockfile installs wrangler 4.148.0. `wrangler pages functions build` compiles a sample Function, so install scripts aren't needed for the bundle.\n- The project `.npmrc` wins over a user config that points to another registry.\n- The config check passes good files, fails each bad case, and fails missing files only with `--require`.\n- The commit choice:\n  - accepts a merged commit followed by non-deployable commits, and the tip;\n  - refuses an unmerged commit, a short SHA, an uppercase SHA, and a commit superseded by newer src;\n  - deploys exactly github.sha on a push.\n- `surface_guard diff` and `check_all.sh . origin/main` pass.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n\nhttps://claude.ai/code/session_012RJPVKAoLga2RkqLYRDcBY\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_012RJPVKAoLga2RkqLYRDcBY)_",
